abstract: Choriocarcinoma is a highly malignant trophoblastic tumour characterised by the secretion of human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG). Depending on its origin, choriocarcinoma is divided into gestational (GCC) or nongestational (NGCC). The prognosis is poor due to its high malignancy and possible hemorrhagic metastasis to distant organs. In the present case, a 40-year-old woman presented to the ophthalmology clinic with intermittent visual disturbances and a headache. An MRI of the head revealed a small, round area of contrast enhancement, suggesting a vascular malformation. A month later, the patient presented to the emergency department after syncope. A head CT scan revealed two large intracerebral hematomas, which were evacuated by craniotomy. However, there were recurrences of intracranial bleeding, some of which were reoperated. During hospitalisation, chest X-ray and CT scans revealed a mass in the right middle lobe of the lung. Successive subcapsular hematomas were detected in both liver lobes; the patient underwent two laparotomies. A gynaecological examination and transvaginal ultrasonography excluded the possibility of pregnancy despite the elevated levels of βhCG. Histopathological examination of the liver tissue confirmed the presence of metastatic foci of choriocarcinoma. The patient received cycles of chemotherapy. After chemotherapy, βhCG decreased.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は極めて悪性度の高い栄養膜性腫瘍で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(β-hCG)を分泌することを特徴とする。発生起源により妊娠性絨毛癌(GCC)と非妊娠性絨毛癌(NGCC)に分類される。悪性度が高く、出血性の遠隔転移を起こしうるため予後は不良である。本症例は、40歳女性が間欠的な視覚障害と頭痛で眼科を受診したものである。頭部MRIで小さな円形の造影域を認め、血管奇形が疑われた。1か月後、失神で救急外来を受診した。頭部CTで2つの大きな脳内血腫が認められ、開頭術で除去された。しかし脳内出血の再発がみられ、一部は再手術された。入院中の胸部X線と胸部CTで右中葉に腫瘤が認められた。両肝葉に被膜下血腫が連続して出現し、患者は2回開腹術を受けた。婦人科診察と経膣超音波検査で、β-hCGが高値であるにもかかわらず妊娠は否定された。肝組織の病理組織学的検査で絨毛癌の転移巣が確認された。患者は化学療法を受け、その後β-hCGは低下した。
